svg.text: Against zzq_fakebroker, 100 QoS 1/2 messages in flight: it counts what a publishing client sends; a subscribing client counts what it receives.
zzq-client acks a QoS 1/2 message once the application took it; rumqttc acks on read. rumqttc speaks MQTT 3.1.1, the rest 5.0.
emqtt publishes QoS 1 and 2 from 100 processes.
MQTT clients, one connection, TCP loopback
Intel Core i7-8700B @ 3.20 GHz (QEMU/KVM), performance governor, turbo off
